description: Amplify your trail-game with the all-new Fourstroke AMP LT built to perform on every terrain. This advanced XC performance machine delivers a progressive riding feel with 120mm of revolutionized APS dual-link suspension travel. Hidden trail-racing power comes curtesy of the trailblazing TQ-HPR50 drive system for nonstop uphill and downhill speed to make sure nothing stands in your way. The full-carbon frame includes our most progressive Big Wheel Concept Race geometry to accommodate two water bottles, an integrated fork stopper and frame protection. Fourstroke AMP LT TWO USA allows you to charge the trails with a Shimano XT 12 spd drivetrain, RockShox SID SL Select+ fork and RockShox SIDLuxe Select+ shock, a DT Swiss M 1900 wheelset with 30mm inner width, X-Fusion Manic seatpost and the powerful TQ-HPR50 drive unit.
